moodys.citation_text: Normaan Transcript chronology: November 2024 Moody's downgrade was from Ba1 to B1. Universe v2 file confirms 'pre-2024 was Ba1'. Universe v2 list places Norman as 'Ba1' starting and 'Caa2' ending — 8-notch fall.

sp.citation_text: S&P Global Ratings disclosure page exists for 'Norman Regional Health System, OK Bond Rating Low' but specific S&P starting rating not surfaced — Moody's is the consistently referenced rater.

fitch.citation_text: No Fitch rating identified for Norman Regional during window. Moody's is sole rater referenced.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Downgraded from Ba1 to B1 (4 notches) with negative outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Precipitous decline in liquidity well in excess of projections; heavy reliance on fully-drawn $25M short-term line of credit; ongoing cash flow losses; CEO resignation; challenges with master facility project; cash to debt below 3%.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's: 'The downgrade of NRH's rating to B1 reflects a material and precipitous decline in liquidity well in excess of projections at the time of our most recent review.' Also: 'NRH is fully drawn on a $25 million line of credit (included in our liquidity calculations) which further weakens leverage metrics with cash to debt below 3%.'

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Downgraded from B1 to Caa2 (4 notches), negative outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Lack of financial flexibility; weak liquidity equivalent to 15-20 days cash on hand; cash entirely reliant on fully drawn bank line; higher labor costs; additional capital spending; deteriorating margins; increased likelihood of default and low recovery value.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's: 'weak liquidity equivalent to 15 to 20 days cash on hand' and 'Cash is entirely reliant on a fully drawn bank line, which increases the likelihood of default and a low recovery value.'

moodys.citation_text: B1 in effect from November 2024 downgrade through window end; subsequent Caa2 downgrade occurred in 2025 (date unclear — may be after window end). Conservatively shown as B1 at 2025-03-31.

sp.citation_text: No active S&P rating identified during window.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's executed a 4-notch downgrade in November 2024 (Ba1 -> B1) which by itself exceeds the 2-notch MULTI_DOWNGRADE threshold. Subsequent Caa2 downgrade in 2025 took total fall to 8 notches from Ba1 starting. Live distress: liquidity at 15-20 DCOH, fully drawn LOC, master facility project cost overruns, CEO turnover.

new_actions.rationale: Material and precipitous decline in liquidity well in excess of projections; heavy reliance on short-term line of credit; ongoing cash flow losses; master facility project challenges. Under review for further downgrade. Negative outlook.
